8: Unless people hold on to the feet of the kind God, who is like an ocean of goodness, it is hard to swim across the other ocean, the sea of life’s troubles.
21: All the good books agree that people who live by strict self-control and have given up their desires deserve more praise than anyone else.
24: A person who controls the five senses with a strong mind, the way a hook controls an elephant, is like a seed that will grow into the highest place of all, freedom from being born again.
359: Whoever understands what truly supports all things, and lives so that every other attachment falls away, will never be touched by the sorrows that ruin people’s efforts.
541: Justice means looking into every case carefully, favoring no one, being fair to all, and then thinking it through before acting.
586: A good spy disguises himself as a holy man who has given up the world, goes into places no one else can, learns everything, and never gives himself away, whatever is done to him.
898: If great people, as strong as mountains, are insulted and decide to destroy someone, even people who seemed safe and settled will be wiped out, together with their families.
519: Good fortune leaves a ruler who wrongly becomes suspicious of a worker who is truly devoted and close to the work.
891: Of all the ways a careful person can protect themselves, the first is never to look down on people who have the power to do whatever they set out to do.
